name: Passive Construction Meta
tagline: A persistent construction or restoration layer where the output of the core activity — currency, completions, or time — is invested into visibly building something that accumulates across sessions: a village, a car, a city, a farm.
desc: A persistent construction or restoration layer where the output of the core activity — currency, completions, or time — is invested into visibly building something that accumulates across sessions: a village, a car, a city, a farm. The constructed object is the long-term destination of play, and its progress may also advance in real time while the user is away (build timers, builders).
